title: Self-hosting onboarding is frustrating
summary: I spent some time trying to set up Buzz on a Ubuntu server on my LAN, and the onboarding experience and documentation currently make this very difficult. The architecture is really interesting, but the current documentation assumes everything is being run on localhost with the Desktop App. Please consider adding a clear "Self-Hosting / LAN Setup" guide, documenting the required environment variables, and explaining the manual git setup for those who just want to use the CLI and a web browser.
